envelope.description: Chat webview: scratchpad button, popup menu, insert-into-input handler

body.title: Chat webview: scratchpad button, popup menu, insert-into-input handler
body.summary: Chat webview DOM + bootstrap in vscode-plugin/src/chat/chat-panel.ts: sibling icon-only #insrc-scratch .attachbtn button next to #insrc-attach, #insrc-scratchmenu .popup.chatmenu (recent + New scratchpad + Browse all + empty/error rows), click listener posting scratch-open-menu, and the insert-into-input handler on #insrc-input (:2784). Attach flow proven untouched by unmodified existing tests; chat-panel.test.ts extended.
acceptanceChecks: #insrc-scratch sibling button (class attachbtn, inline SVG icon, title="scratchpads") rendered directly next to #insrc-attach (:2796) in the statusbar (:2794)

attach flow byte-for-byte untouched — proven by the pre-existing attach tests (chat-shell.test.ts:332-340 and :530, chat-panel.test.ts:5046) passing UNMODIFIED alongside the 'pick-attachments' host case at chat-panel.ts:3566

#insrc-scratchmenu .popup.chatmenu reusing the #insrc-histmenu pattern (:2766; opens upward :2289, rows :2296) renders recent entries + "New scratchpad" + "Browse all" from a 'scratch-list' push, plus empty-state hint and error row ('scratchpads unavailable: <reason>')
bootstrap click listener on #insrc-scratch posts {type:'scratch-open-menu'}; menu rows post scratch-open {id} / scratch-new (titleless) / scratch-browse

host->webview 'insert-into-input' handler applies the deterministic insertion rule to #insrc-input (:2784) only: splice at caret replacing an active range selection; append with one separating newline only when caret at end and value non-empty; focus #insrc-input; #insrc-prompt (:2783) is NEVER a target; never posts submit/cancel
CSS reuses existing .attachbtn/.popup/.item rules; only minimal new styles added
chat-panel.test.ts gains assertions for button markup, menu render from scratch-list, bootstrap post, and insert-into-input mid-draft-caret and active-range cases

tests.name: chat-panel.test.ts: #insrc-scratch sibling button with class attachbtn + inline SVG + title exists next to #insrc-attach (ac2, ac5)
chat-panel.test.ts: #insrc-scratchmenu .popup.chatmenu renders recent items + New scratchpad + Browse all from a scratch-list push, incl. empty-state hint and error row (ac2)

chat-panel.test.ts: host insert-into-input handler inserts into #insrc-input (:2784) per the deterministic rule — caret mid-draft in a non-empty draft, and an active range selection replaced — existing content preserved, focuses it, no submit-turn/cancel-turn posted (ac4)
chat-panel.test.ts + scratch-panel.test.ts: every button in the new UI is icon-only with a title attribute — no visible text content on buttons (ac5)
